faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The quickest answers to the most common questions.

q1.q: How do I make a withdrawal?
q1.a: In Wallet, press “Request a withdrawal”, choose the amount and confirm. You need your bank details (Angolan IBAN) saved in Settings › Bank details, and the minimum is {min}. Only the store owner can request withdrawals.

q2.q: How long does a withdrawal take?
q2.a: The request stays “Pending” in the Wallet history until it is completed, and only one withdrawal can be in progress at a time. How long the money takes to reach your account depends on the destination bank; if it takes longer than expected, contact us with the withdrawal reference.

q3.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
q3.a: The subscription is monthly (30 days), with no lock-in and no automatic renewal: if you do not renew it, access to the dashboard ends when the paid period ends. You can see the end date and renew in Billing and plans (the button on the plan card in the side menu leads there).

q4.q: How do I cancel an order?
q4.a: Open the order in Orders and change its status to “Cancelled”. This is possible while it is “Pending” or “Processing”; once “Shipped” it can no longer be cancelled from the dashboard, and you should contact us.

q5.a: You earn {rate} recurring commission for every active merchant (who subscribes and pays for a plan) that you bring through your exclusive link. On the Affiliates page you see the clicks, sign-ups, referrals and available commission.
